outcome: neurodevelopmental impairment (NDI) including cerebral palsy, cognitive deficit, hearing loss, and blindness
cohort: This study included 1,211 preterm infants born before 32 weeks of gestational age without severe brain injury who survived until at least 36 weeks of corrected age.
finding: Bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD) is independently associated with death or neurodevelopmental impairment (NDI) at 3 years of age in preterm infants without severe neonatal brain injury.
